subject: Lineup without Anthropic landed (e0bf3b7)
body: @nathan-c pushed e0bf3b7. No anthropic: entries left. Auditor openai-api/modalaud/Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct-2507-FP8 (Modal, 4x H100) for the pilot and every E3b run. Judges: dev openai:gpt-5.1; held-out openai:gpt-5.1 + openai-compat:openai/gpt-oss-120b. I picked gpt-5.1 over gpt-5 because its EvalDetectBench probe set is already exported (AUROC 0.802), as you suggested. The generator-family waiver now covers both judges and is reported as WAIVED. llm.py: OPENAI_COMPAT_ENDPOINTS (JSON prefix -> base_url, key_env, usd_per_hour; longest prefix wins; unset = old behaviour), tests/test_llm_endpoints.py; lock released. ONE DEVIATION: the dev target stays openai-compat:Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B on Modal, and Kimi K2.5 is listed as the held-out target, not the main one. Abhi explicitly does not want Tinker runs right now, and the pilot runs on a teammate's Modal (RUN_PILOT.md). Swapping Kimi to the main target is a two-line config change once Abhi and Nathan agree. No GPU run started; waiting for your Modal workspace.
